summary: AI tools such as chatbots cannot be listed as authors. Authors who use AI in preparing a manuscript, including drafting or editing text, must briefly describe that use during submission and are fully responsible for fact-checking outputs. Reviewers must write their own evaluation and may use AI only if they disclose it in the cover letter and the tool guarantees the manuscript won't be used for training.
